questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Ville gerne et sted indenfor EU, for at kunne modtage Erasmus. Italien har altid tiltalt mig, da min morfar plejede at bo der.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Lidt forvirrende, især med valg af fag. Men universitetet har en hjemmeside med information til udvekslingsstuderende og man kan nemt komme i kontakt med dem hvis man har spørgsmål.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Online help desk, hvor man har et zoom-møde med en ansat på universitetet som kan hjælpe en.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Start tidligt. Jeg fandt noget allerede et halvt år før. Der findes Facebook grupper man kan blive en del af, men pas på scammers.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er svært at finde bolig, og man kommer højst sandsynligt til at betale overpris. Svarer til en husleje i KBH.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man skulle checke in online via et zoom opkald.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Online help desk, hvor man kan snakke med uni-personale.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Kunne få de fag jeg ville, der var ikke begrænsninger på antal. Det eneste problem var at finde fag uden overlap.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Tag det roligt, det skal nok løse sig. Det virker som et meget uoverskueligt puslespil i starten, men det kan godt lade sig gøre. På humaniora og sikkert mange andre steder er der ikke begrænsninger på antal, så du kan få de fag du vil have. Og man behøver ikke vælge i starten, så brug den første uges tid på at tage til de fag du synes lyder spændende og se hvad der er fedest.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Niveauet er under KU, i hvert fald humaniora. Tog kandidatfag og det var samme niveau eller under de bachelorfag jeg har haft på KU.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Meget forskelligt. Meget op til den enkelte underviser. Nogle fag mindede meget om hvad jeg er vant til og andre var noget helt andet.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Introduction to Italian Culture
Theories and Methods in Semiotics
Semiotics of Psychopathologies
Geographies of Language
Cognition, Brain and Behavior: Multisensory Integration.

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Var meget glad for Semiotics, især introduktionskurset.
Introduction to Italian Culture er de nemmeste ECTS jeg nogensinde har fået, men har ikke lært vildt meget.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Der er så mange gode restauranter, så spiste meget oftere ude end jeg havde regnet med.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Det er ret billigt at spise ude.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Forskellige sportsgrupper. Ellers mest Erasmus events, i hvert fald hvad jeg opdagede og som var på engelsk. Det meste er på italiensk.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: University Street Party, techno DJ midt på campus, virkelig sjovt og fedt!

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Rejs rundt i Italien, vandre i Dolomitterne og se de andre smukke byerne i nærheden.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Hang meget ud med andre udvekslingstuderende ikke så meget med italienere.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Det er svært, de tager ofte ikke de engelske fag. Men prøv at opsøg de få der gør. Og ellers tag ud i bylivet og mød dem der.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Den manglende struktur og sammenhæng i undervisningen. Virkelig meget op til den enkelte underviser, hvilket betyder at stilen, niveauet og forventningerne var meget forskellige fra fag til fag.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Maden og deres mere rolige tilgang til hverdagen. De har ikke ligeså travlt.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Det virker uoverskueligt med fagvalg og svært at finde hoved og hale i, men tag det roligt, det løser sig!
2. Start tidligt med boligsøgning.
3. Tag til Erasmus events hvis du vil møde andre!

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Hvis du skal rejse rundt i Italien er det ekstremt billigt med bus. Hurtigtog er markant hurtigere men også dyrere.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Det sociale helt klart. At blive venner med folk fra andre lande.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At vælge fag, og at være i en by hvor man ikke kender nogen.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
